text:
Maria Chen: FYI hit an onboarding snag with the sampleapp — ambiguous credential source precedence causing failures in a Private deploy.
Sam Patel: Can you paste what env vars you had?
Maria Chen: ```
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-prod-abc
REDWOOD_ORG=redwood-inc
PROJECT_ID=proj-123
```
Maria Chen: The sampleapp also reads ~/.redwood/credentials and the GCE metadata server. SDK seems to pick metadata over env var in this case which broke local testing.
Jules Rivera: SDK should have a clear, documented precedence: CLI flags > env vars > well-known file (~/.redwood/credentials) > metadata server. Enforce it and add a warning when a lower-precedence source overrides something obvious.
Carol Nguyen: Related: org vs project scoping is confusing. When both REDWOOD_ORG and PROJECT_ID exist, what is the authz decision flow? Right now behaviour defaults to org if key is org-scoped, but there's no hint to the user.
Sam Patel: Proposal: 1) Make keys carry an explicit "scope" (org|project) in the DB. 2) SDK should validate requested resource scope against key.scope and emit a clear error + remediation. 3) Emit telemetry event credential.source with values [flag|env|file|metadata].
Maria Chen: :thumbsup: telemetry would make onboarding friction debug-able. Also recommend adding a small, user-friendly error for metadata timeouts (private deployments).
devex-bot: heads-up — there's an RFC draft at https://go/repo/cred-precedence-draft. Please add examples and edge cases.
Jules Rivera: Edge case: air-gapped Private customers can't reach metadata — SDK must not hang trying indefinitely. Fallback should be immediate with actionable log: "no reachable metadata server; using file/env only".
Jules Rivera: Rotation idea: add a rotation callback hook in SDK so apps can register a handler to refresh tokens without restart. Useful for long-lived services that rotate keys nightly.
Carol Nguyen: For sampleapps we should normalize env var names to REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT (avoid ambiguous PROJECT_ID). Also add a migration note in onboarding docs.
Sam Patel: I'll open a small SDK PR: (a) fix precedence, (b) emit credential.source telemetry, (c) add rotation hook. Assigning @Jules for API review and @Maria to update sampleapp and docs. ETA: EOD Thursday?
Maria Chen: I can update the sampleapp tomorrow and add a test matrix for hosted vs private behaviour.
Jules Rivera: I'll author an RFC for the env var naming + rotation hook and ping @security for leakage/least-privilege review.
devex-bot: Created issue https://go/repo/issues/4823 and assigned the triage labels.
